title: Unique errors from a log
role: Developers and support staff reading long logs
saves: Scrolling hundreds of lines to find which errors happened, and how many kinds
summary: Type =errors and paste a log. You get each distinct error line once, without timestamps.

tests.name: keeps errors, drops info and repeats
tests.input:
2026-10-20T09:00:01Z INFO server started
2026-10-20T09:00:02Z ERROR db timeout after 5s
2026-10-20T09:00:03Z WARN slow request
2026-10-20T09:00:04Z ERROR db timeout after 5s
2026-10-20T09:00:05Z FATAL out of memory
tests.expect:
ERROR db timeout after 5s
FATAL out of memory

tests.name: a log with no errors gives nothing
